title: Add token-phase entropy signatures and contextual sparkline attachments
author: Priya Kaur
description: Motivation: Long-tail latency/cost spikes are often correlated with subtle per-token phase variability (e.g., unexpected KV-cache churn, backend contention, or prompt-shape anomalies). Existing metrics capture aggregated per-invocation costs but lack a compact, explainable signature that surfaces phase-level entropy and a lightweight visual hint in the Console. This PR introduces an entropy-weighted token-phase signature metric, a compact sparkline attachment for invocation traces in the Console, and a synthetic replay harness to validate detection sensitivity across realistic prompt shapes. The description below is a single continuous string with context, implementation notes, and rollout plan. Implementation summary: 1) telemetry/metrics: add token_phase_entropy meter that computes per-invocation token-phase distributions (encode: prefix/kvcache/model-encoder/decoder phases) and emits a small fingerprint (64-bit base64) plus a float entropy score. 2) tracing: enrich sampled spans with token_phase_signature and sparkline url meta; signatures are deterministic hashes of the per-phase token counts so they can be correlated across tenants. 3) console: new sparkline "Phase Entropy" attachment on invocation detail panels (click-to-expand) with hover tooltips showing per-phase counts and delta to baseline. 4) dashboards: dashboard JSON with cohorting by signature cluster and a low-cardinality legend for fast triage. 5) alerts: provide an adaptive alert recipe that combines base token-cost SLO with a delta-over-baseline entropy bucketing to reduce false positives from benign bursts. 6) tests: unit tests for entropy calculation, integration replay bench (synthetic spikes), and an e2e Console render test. Rollout and safety: default telemetry emission is opt-in per-tenant via a feature flag (observability.token_phase_entropy = off). For hosted tenants we roll out for internal beta for 2 weeks, then staged gradual opt-in to customers with heavy debug billing permissions. Privacy: signatures are non-reversible hashes; no raw token text is emitted. Backwards compatibility: metrics use new metric names but do not change existing panels. Docs: internal runbook + playbook for oncall to interpret signatures. Plan to monitor cardinality for 30 days and add reservoir-based sampling if necessary. Links: Linear ENG-9203 (design), ENG-9378 (dashboard design), SUP-4421 (customer support case that motivated anomaly false positives).
commits: 3 commits: (1) add token_phase_entropy meter and unit tests; (2) add console sparkline attachment, dashboard JSON, and render test; (3) add synthetic replay harness and rollout flag + docs

release_notes: Adds an entropy-weighted token-phase signature metric and a Console sparkline attachment for invocation detail pages. Includes a synthetic replay harness and an adaptive alert recipe to reduce false positives. Feature is feature-flagged and off by default for external tenants.
follow_up_items: ENG-9481: reservoir sampler for signature cardinality if >10k/hour
ENG-9510: expose signature cohorts in per-tenant timeline API
DOC-303: public docs and migration notes for observability token metrics
test_plan: Unit tests for entropy and signature determinism; synthetic replay generates three waveform types (steady, burst, skew) and validates detection; e2e Console render test ensures sparkline layout; manual canary on internal tenants for 2 weeks before customer opt-in.
notes_for_oncall: If an entropy alert fires, check invocation detail sparkline and signature cluster. Use synthetic replay to reproduce spike shape. Toggle observability.token_phase_entropy off for tenant if false positives persist.
